title: Portable, validated client agent configuration package
outcome: Implement the observable behavior in tasks/VF-017.md while preserving real installation data.
acceptance: Read and satisfy the complete English specification in tasks/VF-017.md; its boundaries and negative criteria are mandatory.

AC-1 / Export a published configured agent from A / Envelope validates; payload matches that immutable snapshot; no resolved secrets, source DB IDs, accounts, history or bindings / Unit and API integration tests with synthetic secret sentinels

AC-2 / Preview and confirm import into B with current revision / Preview names target and complete resulting config; only target draft/revision/audit change; another refresh returns same config / Browser/API integration

AC-3 / Import malformed/oversized JSON, unsupported package/config version, unknown fields, scalar/array/null config, raw secret fields/values, or invalid provider/model pair / Clear sanitized rejection; no partial draft or audit success; secrets are not echoed / Negative parser/API/browser tests

AC-4 / Use anonymous/viewer, missing CSRF/foreign origin, or stale/concurrent target revision / Server rejects mutation with existing auth/conflict policy; prior/unsaved content preserved / Negative authorization and PostgreSQL concurrency tests

AC-5 / Export/import with missing local provider credentials / Valid draft can be stored; UI identifies required references without values; no provider/network request or activation / Tests with network gateway forbidden

AC-6 / Run independent A and B, import A's package into B and customize B's draft / A stays unchanged; B has independent users/history/secrets/bindings; no shared volume or DB; neither package action activates a version / Two-stack runner with explicit DB/volume identity assertions

AC-7 / Explicitly reset B to base with VF-016 after import / Only B's draft becomes the selected base; A's config and both installs' users/history/active versions remain intact / Two-stack integration plus owner UI acceptance
AC-8 / Restart both installations and remove the downloaded/local package file / Both retain saved DB drafts/users/history; no file-driven reset or reimport occurs / Two-stack runner restart phase

AC-9 / Use existing plain AgentConfig export/import / Existing clients and immutable published snapshot behavior remain compatible; package metadata never changes an existing session pin / Existing regression suite plus new package tests

Use only synthetic disposable data. No home SSH, real .env, provider calls, paid fallback, merge, deployment or automatic owner acceptance. Delegate only bounded subtasks when useful; no two writers in one checkout.
